description: This source file defines classes related to handling connection preambles in Orleans, including serialization, deserialization, and communication over network connections.

classes.name: ConnectionPreamble
classes.description: Represents the connection preamble data, including protocol version, node identity, Silo address, and cluster ID.

classes.name: ConnectionPreambleHelper
classes.description: Provides methods to serialize and deserialize connection preambles over network connections.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a ConnectionPreamble and writes it to the connection output stream.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the connection input stream and deserializes it into a ConnectionPreamble.
